signals.what: Hyperliquid adds address-allowlisted markets in the same week major DEXs ship permissioned pools (CT/venue reporting).
signals.why: Third major venue in ~same week enabling issuer-restricted secondary trading onchain.

signals.what: HL week Jul 13–19: RWA perps ~52–54% of venue volume (~$25B), first time RWA > crypto categories; single stocks ~61% of RWA.
signals.why: Demand already flipped before permissioned-pool week — rails catching up to flow.

signals.what: Week ended Jul 24: spot ETH ETFs +$104M vs BTC ETFs +$34M; 2nd straight week ETH out-raised BTC. BlackRock ETHA +$96M while IBIT saw heavy late-week outflows.
signals.why: Institutional marginal dollar rotating ETH over BTC — pairs with ETH/BTC breakout narrative.

signals.what: Senate leaders push CLARITY Act fact sheet; combined draft + ethics language in play, still multi-step before law. Schwab: Clarity odds explained ~4% of BTC daily moves YTD.
signals.why: Policy theater vs price — useful for provocative 'bill as narrative, not catalyst' take.

signals.what: US–Iran Hormuz pause day 2; Brent −~7%; BTC ~$65k; DeFi tokens lead bounce (AAVE/LDO/ONDO); Fed decision Wed with hike odds trimmed.
signals.why: Macro risk-on backdrop — weak alone, strong as timing context for RWA/DeFi posts.

signals.what: PUMP +~12% day, mcap toward ~$800M from ~$570M two weeks ago — speculative bid alongside DeFi bounce.
signals.why: Same week as permissioned RWA rails: casino and compliance narratives running in parallel.

signals.what: CoinDesk Jul 28: CME sued CFTC/Chair Selig over approving crypto perps for Kalshi + Coinbase; CME also blocked on 24/7 WTI while HL oil/RWA perps already run offshore.
signals.why: Incumbent TradFi using court + regulator fight to slow US onchain perps — same week HL RWA already majority venue volume.

signals.what: Jul 27 spot ETF day: BTC −$11.64M (IBIT −$8.8M) vs ETH +$9.23M, SOL +$1.03M, XRP +$0.59M — third consecutive BTC outflow day after week ETH > BTC.
signals.why: Rotation not just weekly print: daily split still prefers ETH/alts wrappers over BTC.

signals.what: Polymarket July Fed event ~$110M volume: hike ~25% vs cut ~0.3%; odds whipsawed ~7% (Hormuz pause) → ~25–27% into FOMC Jul 28–29.
signals.why: Crypto prediction market is the live Fed thermometer — pairs with oil/risk narrative, not CLARITY PDF.

signals.what: Week to ~Jul 22: Hyperliquid net bridge inflows +$462M (#1); Arbitrum net −$527M (largest outflow). ETH also net positive ~+$137M.
signals.why: Clear liquidity migrate: capital leaving a major L2 into a perp/L1 venue — pairs with HL RWA/perp dominance.

signals.what: DefiLlama snapshot: ETH DeFi TVL ~$41.8B vs SOL ~$5.0B; SOL 24h DEX vol ~$1.50B vs ETH ~$1.13B — SOL leads trade activity, ETH leads locked capital. Base ~$4.65B TVL (top L2 band).
signals.why: Winner tape split: volume chain ≠ TVL chain — useful for 'where activity actually is' takes.

signals.what: Same DefiLlama pull: Tron 24h chain fees ~$955k (ahead of ETH ~$240k / SOL ~$456k) with ~4.24M active addresses — fee winner ≠ narrative winner.
signals.why: Quiet fee leadership often ignored in CT 'L1 wars' posts.

signals.what: DefiLlama bridges: Relay leads ~$175M 24h / ~$1.01B 7d volume; USDT0 ~$130M 24h; Across ~$124M — bridge share concentrating in routing/stable layers.
signals.why: Infra for liquidity migrate is itself a winner tape — not only destination chains.

signals.what: Circle Agent Stack (wallets, nanopayments to $0.000001 USDC, marketplace) live; later open-source kits for LangChain/Claude Agent SDK. USDC cited ~99.8% of x402 agent payments.
signals.why: AI×crypto with real rails — still relevant backdrop if agent-payment narrative reheats; expire if unused.

signals.what: MetaMask Rewards relaunched May 6 with challenges/airdrops/Benefits tab after Season 1 LINEA drop; ongoing points for swaps/perps/card/predictions.
signals.why: Wallet-layer money campaign still active — gravity for retail flow into MetaMask perps/swaps.

signals.what: U.S. Senate shelves Crypto Clarity Act for now (Russia sanctions + nominations first); ~2 weeks floor time before Aug 8 recess — bill path this year uncertain.
signals.why: Same-day policy print that actually moved risk tape with Fed/Kospi — upgrades Clarity-as-narrative thesis with a dated delay receipt.

signals.what: Jul 28 risk-off: Kospi −~11% (worst day in years); BTC ~−2–3%; AI/L1 tokens (FET/NEAR/HYPE) hit hardest into Fed decision day.
signals.why: Macro tape > crypto-native catalyst for the day — pairs with Clarity delay + Fed.

signals.what: Jul 27 reporting: SOL ETFs ~$904M AUM; HYPE ETFs ~$350M since May launch — inflows continuing while BTC ETF complex has been in outflow streak narrative.
signals.why: Alt wrappers still taking dollars — extends rotation beyond ETH-only story.

signals.what: Coinbase opens Launches tab (Jul 27): trade newly minted Base + Solana tokens in-app via DEX (Jupiter for SOL) without CEX listing wait.
signals.why: CEX distribution layer for casino/new-launch meta — 100M-user funnel into onchain launches.

signals.what: HL SK Hynix USDC perp flash −~20% to $900 in 1 min then rebound; preceded Kospi/chip selloff (Hynix shares ~−15%, Kospi −11%).
signals.why: RWA/stock perps on HL now front-run TradFi tape — same venue as RWA volume majority story.

signals.what: Morgan Stanley launches ETH (MSSE) + SOL (MSOL) ETPs on NYSE Arca: 0.14% fee (market-low), staking rewards passed to investors; builds on MSBT BTC ~$381M AUM.
signals.why: Major bank distribution beyond BTC into ETH+SOL same day as Clarity delay — wrappers keep expanding while policy stalls.

signals.what: Garden Finance takes app offline after ~$450k USDT drain via compromised independent solver off-chain DB (HTLCs on ETH/Base/ARB/BSC); protocol says contracts/user funds untouched.
signals.why: Bridge/swap trust lives in solver ops, not just contracts — failure-mode take.

signals.what: WEMIX3.0 freezes bridges/LPs/services after compromised owner mints ~5.23M unauthorized WEMIX$; converted to WEMIX + USDC.e and bridged out.
signals.why: Stablecoin mint via key/owner compromise → full network pause — classic failure tape.

signals.what: AFX Trade Arbitrum bridge drained ~$24.15M USDC (validator keys/quorum); native Arbitrum bridge unaffected; funds swapped to ~12.5k ETH.
signals.why: Custom bridge ≠ L2 security — backdrop for Garden/solver week.
